display.name: Asana
display.blurb: Read and manage Asana tasks, projects, comments, and tags — authenticated with a personal access token that the egress proxy injects, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc:
Use `asana` to interact with Asana from this session — read and manage tasks, projects, comments, and tags. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects your personal access token (PAT) on requests to app.asana.com; `ASANA_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login.

All endpoints sit under https://app.asana.com/api/1.0. Asana wraps responses as {"data": ...} and request bodies as {"data": {...}}. The CLI sends `Accept: application/json` (and `Content-Type: application/json` on writes) for you. GIDs are opaque numeric-string ids.

Identity / discovery:
  asana whoami                          Current user (GET /users/me)
  asana workspaces                      List your workspaces (requires users:read)
  asana users [workspace=<gid>]         List users (requires users:read)

Tasks (tasks:read / tasks:write):
  asana tasks project=<gid>             List tasks in a project (GET /tasks; one of project/assignee+workspace/section/tag is required by Asana)
  asana task <task-gid>                 Get a single task (GET /tasks/{gid})
  asana task-create name="My task" projects=<gid> [notes=...] [assignee=me]  Create a task (POST /tasks)
  asana task-update <task-gid> completed=true [name=...] [notes=...]         Update a task (PUT /tasks/{gid})
  asana search <workspace-gid> text=<q> [opt_fields=name,completed]          Search tasks (GET /workspaces/{gid}/tasks/search)

Comments / stories (stories:read / stories:write):
  asana stories <task-gid>              List a task's stories/comments (GET /tasks/{gid}/stories)
  asana comment <task-gid> <text...>    Add a comment (POST /tasks/{gid}/stories, type=comment)

Projects (projects:read / projects:write):
  asana projects [workspace=<gid>]      List projects (GET /projects)
  asana project <project-gid>           Get a project (GET /projects/{gid})
  asana project-create name="Q3 plan" workspace=<gid>  Create a project (POST /projects)

Tags (tags:read): asana tags [workspace=<gid>]  List tags (GET /tags).

Escape hatches (still gated by your granted powers at the proxy):
  asana get  <path> [field=value ...]   Raw GET  (query params), e.g. asana get /tasks project=123
  asana post <path> [field=value ...]   Raw POST (sent as JSON {"data":{...}})
  asana api  <METHOD> <path> [-d '{json}']  Fully raw call.

Each subcommand needs the matching power on your profile; a call to a path/method your profile didn't grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.
